mutant.description: Reverts the ISS-0808 fix by bypassing roles_from_strings/1, leaving `roles` as the raw string list from auth_context instead of the normalized atom list. Since @platform_admin is the atom :PLATFORM_ADMIN, the `in` comparison against a string list always fails: :PLATFORM_ADMIN not in ["PLATFORM_ADMIN"] is true, so every PLATFORM_ADMIN caller against an :inactive tenant receives 403.

mutant_diff_confirmed: git diff shows exactly one line changed; verified with `git diff lib/letflow/plugs/tenant_status.ex`

failure_analysis.environment_note: mix test cannot run in this environment — earmark_parser, pdf, eqrcode unavailable (confirmed: 'mix test' exits with "Can't continue due to errors on dependencies"). Failure counts are determined by static type analysis of Elixir's `in` operator semantics.
failure_analysis.elixir_typing_basis: Elixir's `in` operator uses `==` (structural equality). The atom :PLATFORM_ADMIN and the string "PLATFORM_ADMIN" are different types, so :PLATFORM_ADMIN == "PLATFORM_ADMIN" is false. With `roles = raw_roles = ["PLATFORM_ADMIN"]`, `:PLATFORM_ADMIN not in roles` evaluates to `true`, so `reject_inactive/1` fires and `conn.halted` becomes true.
